notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Small hotfixes for both the full version and demo:

[list]
[*] Skirmish waves sent incorrect enemies in endless waves. They should now - I mean I hope - send enemies based on the planet you play on!
[*] Typo fixed in Tutorial that indicated the Start Wave button to be in the top left corner, whereas it is in the top right corner!
[/list]
